name: ARENA BASS

sub: 808 subs, slap, reese, acid and horns
gumroad_title: ARENA BASS - Bass Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | 808, Reese, Slap, Acid
summary: A bass synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (sine sub, slap, analog-style mono bass, reese, FM growl, acid, horns and kick) and 70 factory presets.
about: ARENA BASS, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
61 of the 70 presets load in Mono mode for clean one-note bass lines; the nine chord-ready Stadium Horns presets load in Poly mode, which plays up to 16 voices.
Built for Trap, Drill and Hip-Hop 808s, Afrotrap and Afro bass, G-Funk slides, Deep House and acid lines.

features.d: Sine sub with pitch knock, slap, analog-style mono bass, stadium reese, FM growl, acid rubber, horns and kick.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from 808 subs to stadium horns.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated ADSR.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 36 to 84), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: ARENA BASS plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .abpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
